summary: Frontend testing of redesigned Chutex Care homepage hero and header. All 16 features tested and passed. Hero displays full-screen background image (couple in flowers) with dark gradient overlay, centered white title with blue gradient 'prevention' highlight, and two CTA buttons. Header has glassmorphism effect - transparent with white text/logo over hero, transitions to white glass with dark text/black logo on scroll. Search/Account/Cart icons visible with cart badge. Language selector shows country flags (FR/EN) with working dropdown. Navigation links have animated underline on hover. Mobile hamburger menu works with proper styling.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling ipapi.co/json/ for language/currency auto-detection. Site falls back to browser language detection which works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Header glassmorphism implementation is excellent with proper backdrop-blur transitions
Logo switching (white/black) on scroll works correctly via isLight state
Language selector with country flags from flagcdn.com loads properly
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Framer-motion animations on hero elements work smoothly
Mobile responsive design properly hides desktop nav and shows hamburger menu
test_credentials: N/A - marketing site with no authentication
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chutex Care homepage redesign is complete and working. Hero uses full-screen banner_login_mobile.jpg image with dark gradient overlay. All sections below hero work: Products (Elder 879€, Elio 24.9€/month, Vita 229€), Stats (0.08s, 36h, 50m, 10+), App Section, Testimonials (3 items), CTA Section, Footer.
